description: Mandatory certificates have certificate_type = 'Pflichtzertifikat'. Note: this value exists only in mt_safe_user, NOT in mt_safe_certificate.
Elective certificates have certificate_type = 'Wahlzertifikat'. Available in both mt_safe_user and mt_safe_certificate.
Active companies: company_status_simple = 'ACTIVE' (uppercase). Values are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TRIAL.
Completed assignments: user_course_state = 'COMPLETED' (uppercase). Values are: COMPLETED, NOTSTARTED, INPROGRESS, FINISHEDWATCHING.
Classify assignments as On Time, Late, Not Completed by comparing completedOn vs deadline_assignment.
rule_logic: CASE WHEN completedOn IS NOT NULL AND deadline_assignment IS NOT NULL AND completedOn <= deadline_assignment THEN 'On Time' WHEN completedOn IS NOT NULL AND deadline_assignment IS NOT NULL AND completedOn > deadline_assignment THEN 'Late' WHEN completedOn IS NULL AND deadline_assignment IS NOT NULL THEN 'Not Completed' ELSE 'No Deadline' END

description: Days between completion and deadline. Negative = early, positive = late.
rule_logic: DATEDIFF(CAST(completedOn AS DATE), CAST(deadline_assignment AS DATE))

description: mt_safe_user has is_certificate_a_duplicate and Nr_Certificates_for_the_same_year for duplicate cert detection.
Closed-won opportunities: is_closed = true AND is_won = true.
rule_logic: WHERE is_closed = true AND is_won = true

description: IMPORTANT: mt_safe_certificate contains ONLY Wahlzertifikat (elective) certificates. For mandatory certificates (Pflichtzertifikat), use mt_safe_user WHERE certificate_type = 'Pflichtzertifikat'. For all certificate types combined, use mt_safe_user.
rule_logic: For mandatory certs: use mt_safe_user WHERE certificate_type = 'Pflichtzertifikat'. For elective certs: use mt_safe_certificate OR mt_safe_user WHERE certificate_type = 'Wahlzertifikat'.
